flags.message: The as-stored snapshot (2026-10-05.json, and per the candidates the 2026-09-17 snapshot too) dates the 'Petition for a writ of certiorari filed' proceeding Apr 13 2026, the same date as the extension application, while the linked PDF is stamped 2026-05-26 and the docket's DocketedDate is June 1, 2026.
